name: studio
description:
Make finished files with your AI — decks, documents, PDFs, videos and designs — built by real engines and checked before they are handed over.
Available skills:
Presentation: a designed PowerPoint deck from an outline, notes or a document — charts, tables, explainer diagrams that build up click by click, a video on a slide.
Short video: a narrated video with motion graphics — animated charts (waterfall, before/after, forecast band, ranking race, Sankey…), camera moves, music.
Graphics on your own video: name bars, charts, split screen and full-screen inserts on footage, tied to what is said.
Documents: write and edit Word files precisely — tracked changes, review comments, tables of contents.
Check and fix: every file is laid out and checked; problems name the exact shape or paragraph, with a ready fix.
Old books and scans: photographed pages into an editable Word file, doubtful readings marked, never guessed.
Every file opens in a built-in editor (Word-, PowerPoint-, Photoshop-, After Effects-like) for the final touches.
